page.overview:
Who is Luthir Veremonn Goreman?

Luthir Veremonn Goreman is the Lord Marshal of the Calixian Great Precinct, which makes him the commander of all Adeptus Arbites forces operating within the Calixis Sector of the Segmentum Obscurus. He operates out of the Great Precinct Fortress, called the Fortress of Justice, on the sector capital world of Scintilla.

Goreman has little respect for the great masses of Humanity, who he sees as forever failing to live up to the ideals of the Emperor of Mankind and His Imperium. Goreman was responsible for the creation of the Divisio Immoralis, a special Arbites taskforce intended to deal with the unusual number of festering threats that exist within Calixian space.

For Lord Marshal Goreman, every medal pinned to his dress uniform, every honorific and citation attached to his name, every pennant, seal, and chain hanging from the plaque atop his staff of office, all prove the same thing: that he is right in his ironclad disdain for the great mass of the Imperium's populace.

Goreman hails from the once-grand Sorascine Canyon conurbation on the world of Sinophia, steeped in all the many kinds of decay that that world had to offer. He was born into an extended family of butchers and flesh-thieves, descended from once proud dynasties of medicae and lay biologis adepts back when the world had been in its prime. The old family seat, with its surgical chambers and tissue molds, where generations ago the sub-sector's nobility had come for medicae and rejuvenat treatments, or to buy exquisitely flesh-sculpted servitors, had become a charnel house. Their old family name now lost, the Gore-Men conducted a lively and ruthless trade in spare organs and tissues to any who could meet their price, and trained their young man in the brutal skills needed to ensure a constant supply of "donors."
